sys_remote_update_set.description:
The Okta Workflows - Manage Resource Owner update set provides pre-built workflows, helper flows, and custom API connections designed to automate the lifecycle and assignment of Resource Owners within Okta Identity Governance (OIG) and Okta Workflows.
It enables IT and Security Operations teams to dynamically assign, update, and audit ownership for access requests, entitlement catalogs, and governance resources without manual intervention.
sys_remote_update_set.name: Okta-Workflow-Manage Resource Owner

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_2d0264fe47dfcb1083a1981f316d4362
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1647345_okta_w_0.OIGOktaAPIQueryAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description>OIG</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>OIGOktaAPIQueryAjax</name><sandbox_callable>true</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var OIGOktaAPIQueryAjax = Class.create();
OIGOktaAPIQueryAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    getOktaApplicationsName: function(searchText) {
        var applications = [];
        var appId = !this.getParameter('sysparm_search') ? searchText : this.getParameter('sysparm_search');
        var inputs = {};
        inputs.app_id = String(appId); // String
        var flowName = 'x_1647345_okta_w_0.okta_workflows__get_application_filter_by_name';

        // Execute Synchronously: Run in foreground. Code snippet has access to outputs.
        var outputs = this._executeFlow(flowName, inputs);

        var response = outputs['response']; // JSON
        var status_code = outputs['status_code']; // String
        if (status_code == '200') {

            var parsedObject = JSON.parse(response);
            var dataArray = parsedObject;

            for (var i = 0; i < dataArray.length; i++) {
                var item = dataArray[i];
                applications.push({
                    id: item.id,
                    name: item.label,
                    orn: item.orn
                });
            }
        }
        return JSON.stringify(applications);
    },

    getOktaBundlesbyApp: function(app_id) {
        var entitlements = [];
        var appId = this.getParameter('app_id');
        var inputs = {};

        inputs.application_id = appId; // String

        var flowName = 'x_1647345_okta_w_0.okta_workflows__get_bundles_by_app';

        // Execute Synchronously: Run in foreground. Code snippet has access to outputs.
        var outputs = this._executeFlow(flowName, inputs);

        var response = outputs['response']; // JSON
        var status_code = outputs['status_code']; // String
        if (status_code == '200') {

            var parsedObject = JSON.parse(response);
            var dataArray = parsedObject.data;

            if (dataArray != null) {
                for (var i = 0; i < dataArray.length; i++) {
                    var item = dataArray[i];
                    entitlements.push({
                        id: item.id,
                        name: item.name
                    });

                }
            }
        }
        return JSON.stringify(entitlements);

    },

    getOktaEntitlementsbyApp: function(app_id) {
        var entitlements = [];
        var appId = this.getParameter('app_id');
        var inputs = {};

        inputs.app_id = appId;

        var flowName = 'x_1647345_okta_w_0.okta_workflows__get_entitlements_by_app';

        var outputs = this._executeFlow(flowName, inputs);

        var response = outputs['response'];
        var status_code = outputs['status_code'];
        if (status_code == '200') {

            var parsedObject = JSON.parse(response);
            var dataArray = parsedObject.data;

            if (dataArray != null) {
                for (var i = 0; i < dataArray.length; i++) {
                    var item = dataArray[i];
                    entitlements.push({
                        id: item.id,
                        name: item.name
                    });

                }
            }
        }
        return JSON.stringify(entitlements);

    },

    getOktaResourceOwnersType: function(searchText) {
        try {
            var inputs = {};
            inputs['app_id'] = this.getParameter('orn_id'); // String
            inputs['type'] = this.getParameter('type'); // String
            inputs['resource_name'] = this.getParameter('resource_name');
            var result = sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner().subflow('x_1647345_okta_w_0.okta_workflows__retrieve_resource_owners').inForeground().withInputs(inputs).run();
            var outputs = result.getOutputs();

            // Get Outputs:
            // Note: outputs can only be retrieved when executing synchronously.
            var no_owners = outputs['no_owners']; // True/False
            var approvers = outputs['approvers']; // String
            var users = outputs['users']; // String
            var response = {
                users: users,
                approvers: approvers,
                no_owners: no_owners
            };

            return JSON.stringify(response);

        } catch (ex) {
            var message = ex.getMessage();
            gs.error(message);
        }

    },

    getOktaEntitlementValue: function() {
        try {
            var entitlementId = this.getParameter('sysparm_entitlement_id'); // Renamed to clarify it's the sys_id
            var entitlementValues = [];
            var inputs = {};
            inputs['entitlement_id'] = entitlementId; // String

            var result = sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner().datastream('x_1647345_okta_w_0.okta_workflows__look_up_entitlement_values_by_entitlement').withInputs(inputs).run();
            var stream = result.getDataStream();

            while (stream.hasNext()) {

                var targetObject = stream.next();
                entitlementValues.push({
                    label: targetObject.name,
                    value: targetObject.id
                });
                //                 if (stream.getItemIndex() >= 9) {
                //                     break;
                //                 }
            }
            return JSON.stringify(entitlementValues);
        } catch (ex) {
            var message = ex.getMessage();
            gs.error(message);
        } finally {
            stream.close();
        }
    },

    _executeFlow: function(flowName, inputs) {
        try {
            return this._runFlowAction(flowName, inputs);
        } catch (ex) {
            gs.error('Error executing flow' + flowName + ': ' + ex.getMessage());
        }
    },
    _runFlowAction: function(flowName, inputs) {
        var result = sn_fd.FlowAPI.getRunner().action(flowName).inForeground().withInputs(inputs).run();
        var outputs = result.getOutputs();
        return outputs;
    },
    type: 'OIGOktaAPIQueryAjax'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-16 18:08:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>2d0264fe47dfcb1083a1981f316d4362</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>OIGOktaAPIQueryAjax</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Okta Workflows" source="x_1647345_okta_w_0">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Okta Workflows">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_2d0264fe47dfcb1083a1981f316d4362</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-17 01:36:32</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }

    var ga = new GlideAjax('x_1647345_okta_w_0.OIGOktaAPIQueryAjax');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getOktaBundlesbyApp');
    ga.addParam('app_id', newValue);
    ga.getXMLAnswer(getResponse);

    function getResponse(response) {
        if (response != '[]') {
            var bundlesArray = JSON.parse(response);
            for (var i = 0; i < bundlesArray.length; i++) {
                var bundle = bundlesArray[i];
                g_form.addOption('bundles', bundle.id, bundle.name);
            }
        }
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-16 17:55:29</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>791fdc3a47dfcb1083a1981f316d43d1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Fill Bundles</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Okta Workflows" source="x_1647345_okta_w_0">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Okta Workflows">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_791fdc3a47dfcb1083a1981f316d43d1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-16 18:23:03</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Manage a Resource Owner">ec1f5c3a47dfcb1083a1981f316d4358</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:341f5c3a47dfcb1083a1981f316d43c2</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Get Owners</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue == '' || newValue == 'ADD') {
        g_form.setVisible('new_resource_owner', false);
        g_form.hideAllFieldMsgs('new_resource_owner');
        return;
    }
    g_form.setVisible('new_resource_owner', false);

    var requestorSysId = g_user.userID;
    var ga = new GlideAjax('x_1647345_okta_w_0.OIGOktaAPIQueryAjax');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getOktaResourceOwnersType');
    ga.addParam('orn_id', g_form.getValue('orn_id'));
    ga.addParam('resource_name', g_form.getValue('resource_name'));
    ga.addParam('type', g_form.getValue('resource_type'));
    ga.getXMLAnswer(getResponse);

    function getResponse(response) {
        if (response != '') {
            var parsedObject;

            try {
                parsedObject = JSON.parse(response);
            } catch (e) {
                return;
            }

            if (parsedObject.no_owners == true) {
                return;
            }

            if (parsedObject.approvers != '') {
                var ownersString = parsedObject.approvers || '';
                var ownersArray = ownersString.split(',').filter(String);

                var ownerCount = ownersArray.length;
                var isRequestorAnOwner = ownersArray.indexOf(requestorSysId) > -1;
                if (isRequestorAnOwner) {
                    if (ownerCount == 1) {
                        g_form.setVisible('new_resource_owner', true);
                        g_form.showFieldMsg('new_resource_owner', 'A resource must have at least one owner assigned');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-16 17:55:29</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>291fdc3a47dfcb1083a1981f316d43af</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Get Owners</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Okta Workflows" source="x_1647345_okta_w_0">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Okta Workflows">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_291fdc3a47dfcb1083a1981f316d43af</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-16 18:20:33</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Manage a Resource Owner">ec1f5c3a47dfcb1083a1981f316d4358</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:5d1f9c3a47dfcb1083a1981f316d43bb</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Get Owners (Application)</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue == ''|| g_form.getValue('resource_type') != 'apps') {
        return;
    }
	g_form.setVisible('new_resource_owner',false);
    //Get the current user sys_id for comparison
    var requestorSysId = g_user.userID;
    // Call the GlideAjax script include
    var ga = new GlideAjax('x_1647345_okta_w_0.OIGOktaAPIQueryAjax');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getOktaResourceOwnersType');
    ga.addParam('orn_id', g_form.getValue('orn_id'));
    ga.addParam('type', g_form.getValue('resource_type'));
    ga.getXMLAnswer(getResponse);

    function getResponse(response) {
        if (response != '') {
            var parsedObject;

            try {
                parsedObject = JSON.parse(response);
            } catch (e) {
                return;
            }

            if (parsedObject.no_owners == true) {
                g_form.removeOption('action_to_perform', 'REMOVE MYSELF');
                g_form.removeOption('action_to_perform', 'REMOVE');
                return;
            }


            var ownersString = parsedObject.approvers || '';
            var ownersArray = ownersString.split(',').filter(String);

            var ownerCount = ownersArray.length;
            var isRequestorAnOwner = ownersArray.indexOf(requestorSysId) > -1;
            if (isRequestorAnOwner) {
                if (ownerCount === 1) {
				g_form.setVisible('new_resource_owner',true);
				g_form.showFieldMsg('new_resource_owner','Reassign a new owner to the resource');
                } 
            } 
        }
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-16 17:55:29</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>3d1fdc3a47dfcb1083a1981f316d43c6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Get Owners (Application)</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Okta Workflows" source="x_1647345_okta_w_0">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Okta Workflows">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_3d1fdc3a47dfcb1083a1981f316d43c6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-16 18:22:02</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }
    g_form.clearOptions('select_entitlement_value');
    var ga = new GlideAjax('x_1647345_okta_w_0.OIGOktaAPIQueryAjax');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getOktaEntitlementValue');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_entitlement_id', newValue);
    ga.getXMLAnswer(getResponse);

    function getResponse(response) {
        if (response != '[]') {
            var entitlementsArray = JSON.parse(response);
            for (var i = 0; i < entitlementsArray.length; i++) {
                var entitlement = entitlementsArray[i];
                g_form.addOption('select_entitlement_value', entitlement.value, entitlement.label);
            }
        }
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-16 17:55:28</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>e91fdc3a47dfcb1083a1981f316d43a4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Fill Entitlements values</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Okta Workflows" source="x_1647345_okta_w_0">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Okta Workflows">1d1f06c18305321027abc7a6feaad330</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_e91fdc3a47dfcb1083a1981f316d43a4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-16 18:23:52</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
